purpose: 在 PG-03 Catalog 上训练更强的双视图 Rule IR 解码基线，并用 fail-closed 支持门减少小样本族外误报。

model.architecture: surface/context two-tower -> gated fusion -> 96-d embedding -> 5-way classifier
model.augmentation: five noisy views per training row

decision_policy.support_gate_action: force abstain if predicted family has fewer than two training rows
decision_policy.rule_ir_emission: only after confidence, margin, novelty, support and grammar gates pass

splits.source_split_same_family: source suffix a trains, suffix b tests
splits.family_holdout_unseen_surface: xss/injection train; access_control/logic/url_redirect test on unseen HTTP-canary surface

interpretation.exit_found: predicted family equals local maze semantic family and a valid Rule IR is emitted
interpretation.false_positive: non-abstained predicted family differs from local maze semantic family
